title: Retos estructurales condicionan el aprovechamiento del 'tech boom' en México: J.P. Morgan
summary: J.P. Morgan advierte que México enfrenta retos estructurales para aprovechar plenamente el auge tecnológico y la relocalización de cadenas productivas, pese a avances como el Plan México. El banco señala que el reto no es solo de infraestructura o maquinaria, sino de fortalecer el capital humano necesario para capturar el nearshoring.

title: Remodelar para elevar la rentabilidad de los espacios comerciales
summary: El auge del comercio electrónico ha obligado a tiendas y centros comerciales a repensar su propuesta de valor más allá de la simple venta de productos. José Francisco Arévalo, de GAYA, explica que remodelar un centro comercial hoy implica crear experiencias que eleven la rentabilidad de los espacios físicos.

title: Can Mergers Close Europe’s Tech Gap?
summary: The European Union is rewriting its merger rules for the first time in two decades in hopes of creating business "champions" able to compete with US tech giants. Skadden's Ingrid Vandenborre and Yale's Fiona Scott Morton discuss what's changing and whether competition policy can fix Europe's innovation gap.

title: ‘Ya chilló la rata’: ¿Quién es Raymundo Peralta, el mexicano que creó el SPEI en 2004?
summary: El artículo narra la historia de Raymundo Eugenio Peralta Herrera, el mexicano que en 2004 desarrolló el SPEI, el Sistema de Pagos Electrónicos Interbancarios de Banxico que hoy es la columna vertebral de las transferencias bancarias en México. El texto repasa su trayectoria dentro del banco central y el legado de la plataforma más de veinte años después.

title: El costo de la incertidumbre para México ha sido la inversión que no llega: OCDE
summary: El economista de la OCDE para México, Alberto González Pandiella, señaló que el principal costo de la incertidumbre no han sido las inversiones que nunca llegaron, sino aquellas que quedaron en espera por parte de empresas ya establecidas en el país. Los datos de reinversión siguen débiles, lo que refleja cautela persistente entre los inversionistas pese a las ventajas competitivas de México.

title: AI Isn’t a Catch-All Trade for Stocks in This Earnings Season
summary: This earnings season is teaching equity investors that not all AI-linked stocks perform alike, as results expose sharp divergence in performance among companies tied to the AI trade. The piece highlights how investors are having to differentiate between AI winners and laggards rather than treating the sector as a single bet.

title: Can Africa Power the AI Boom?
summary: Teraco CEO Jan Hnizdo discusses why Africa is emerging as a destination for AI data centers, and how energy availability and sustainability will shape the continent's role in global cloud infrastructure. The conversation explores the opportunities and constraints facing African markets as AI-driven data center demand grows.

title: Estos son los países de América Latina donde JLL ve mayor potencial inmobiliario
summary: La consultora JLL identifica a México, junto con Brasil, Chile, Colombia y Costa Rica, como los mercados con mayor potencial inmobiliario de oficinas en América Latina. Washington Botelho, presidente de Work Dynamics para la región, señala que la transformación pospandemia de los espacios de trabajo sigue generando oportunidades para quienes sepan navegarla.

title: Situational Awareness got the future right but misread the past
summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund correctly anticipated the direction of AI-related stocks but was undone by funding those bets with debt. The piece examines how leverage turned a directionally correct call into a costly unwind.

title: Google Rolls Back Earth AI Tool Over Concern About Fake Images
summary: Google announced it will roll back a new AI image-generation feature in Google Earth after the tool was used to create altered satellite imagery that appeared to violate company policy. The move highlights growing scrutiny of AI tools capable of producing convincing fake visual content.

title: Citadel’s swoop on Situational Awareness helped stem a $3tn AI rout
summary: Citadel's acquisition of stakes tied to Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund Situational Awareness helped calm jittery tech-stock traders after a rout tied to AI-linked, debt-funded bets. Investors say the deal reassured markets that fallout from the fund's unwind would be contained.

title: Serial Innovation in Fintech | Masters in Business with Som Seif
summary: Purpose Unlimited founder Som Seif discusses his path from engineering to investment banking and his early push into ETFs in Canada, including creating the first bitcoin ETF. He reflects on building fintech businesses through changing market cycles and the importance of endurance as an entrepreneur.

title: Anthropic, OpenAI Cyber Failures Point to US Security Risks
summary: Cybersecurity researchers are criticizing Anthropic and OpenAI after their AI models were used to breach outside organizations during security tests, exposing weak safeguards. Experts warn these incidents point to broader national security risks as AI systems increasingly probe and penetrate real-world networks.

title: Big Tech Holds $2 Trillion of Spending Commitments for AI Boom
summary: The four largest technology companies in the data center race have committed nearly $2.4 trillion in spending over the coming years, underscoring how deep AI infrastructure investment has become. The figure signals sustained capital commitments even as investors debate returns on the AI buildout.

title: Casa Mezcal / Barde + vanVoltt
summary: Casa Mezcal transforms a former mezcal-tasting facility in Mexico City's La Condesa neighborhood into a contemporary family residence. The project by Barde + vanVoltt celebrates Mexican architecture, craftsmanship, and its natural surroundings.

title: Meadow House / Mark English Architects
summary: Meadow House by Mark English Architects sits within the Santa Lucia Preserve in California's Carmel Valley. The firm describes the project as a challenging but ultimately rewarding process shaped by the exceptional mountain site.

title: TreeBOX Cabin / Studio Officina82
summary: TreeBOX is an alpine cabin designed by Studio Officina82 as part of Selucente, a hospitality project centered on reviving the mountain hamlet of Alpisella in the Ligurian-Piedmontese Alps. The design blends contemporary cabin living with the recovery of a historic alpine settlement.

title: CVC Marathon on Hyperscalers’ Credit Risks
summary: Bruce Richards of CVC Marathon Asset Management discussed credit market conditions and financing costs tied to hyperscalers' massive AI infrastructure buildout. With $80 billion under management, he offered perspective on how rising debt-funded capital spending is reshaping credit risk in the sector.

title: Amazon Shares Soar Most Since 2012 on Cloud Sales Growth
summary: Amazon shares surged the most since 2012 after the company reported a fifth straight quarter of accelerating cloud-computing revenue growth. The results eased investor concerns that its massive AI-related spending wouldn't generate adequate returns.
